mainEntity.name: What is the process and how long before I see US coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks are a narrative teardown and journalist mapping. Outreach starts in week three with exclusives or embargo pitches to US tier-1 desks. For a launch moment with a real embargo, tier-1 placements typically land within the first 24 to 48 hours. Ongoing retainer work builds compounding coverage across four to twelve weeks. Six to twelve weeks of lead time before a public moment is the ideal window.
